article_context: 文章分析即将进入职场的Z世代：他们成长于2008年金融危机并背负高额学贷，因此比千禧一代更务实谨慎，尤其重视就业安全、稳定与可预见的未来。

article.title: 阅读 Text 4 · Z 世代求职更看重确定性与稳定
article.background: 文章分析即将进入职场的Z世代：他们成长于2008年金融危机并背负高额学贷，因此比千禧一代更务实谨慎，尤其重视就业安全、稳定与可预见的未来。

sentences.en: Now that members of Generation Z are graduating college this spring—the most commonly-accepted definition says this generation was born after 1995, give or take a year—the attention has been rising steadily in recent weeks.
sentences.zh: 随着Z世代成员在今年春天大学毕业——最常见的定义认为这一代人大约出生于1995年以后——近几周公众对他们的关注持续升温。

segments.text: Now that members of Generation Z are graduating college this spring—the most commonly-accepted definition says this generation was born after 1995, give or take a year—the attention has been rising steadily in recent weeks.

sentences.en: Gen Zs are about to hit the streets looking for work in a labor market that's tighter than it's been in decades.
sentences.zh: Z世代即将在一个数十年来最紧俏的劳动力市场中开始求职。

segments.text: Gen Zs are about to hit the streets looking for work in a labor market that's tighter than it's been in decades.

sentences.en: And employers are planning on hiring about 17 percent more new graduates for jobs in the U.S. this year than last, according to a survey conducted by the National Association of Colleges and Employers.
sentences.zh: 美国全国高校与雇主协会的一项调查显示，今年雇主计划招聘的美国应届毕业生比去年多约17%。

segments.text: And employers are planning on hiring about 17 percent more new graduates for jobs in the U.S. this year than last, according to a survey conducted by the National Association of Colleges and Employers.

sentences.en: Everybody wants to know how the people who will soon inhabit those empty office cubicles will differ from those who came before them.
sentences.zh: 人人都想知道，这些即将坐进空置办公隔间的年轻人与前辈会有何不同。

segments.text: Everybody wants to know how the people who will soon inhabit those empty office cubicles will differ from those who came before them.

sentences.en: If “entitled” is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.
sentences.zh: 如果说“自我中心”——无论公不公平——是最常被用来形容千禧一代（1981至1995年出生）的话，那么Z世代的关键词则是务实和谨慎。

segments.text: If “entitled” is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.

sentences.en: According to the career counselors and experts who study them, Generation Zs are clear-eyed, economic pragmatists.
sentences.zh: 研究他们的职业顾问和专家认为，Z世代头脑清醒，是经济上的实用主义者。

segments.text: According to the career counselors and experts who study them, Generation Zs are clear-eyed, economic pragmatists.

sentences.en: Despite graduating into the best economy in the past 50 years, Gen Zs know what an economic train wreck looks like.
sentences.zh: 尽管毕业时遇上过去50年来最好的经济环境，Z世代却很清楚经济灾难是什么样子。

segments.text: Despite graduating into the best economy in the past 50 years, Gen Zs know what an economic train wreck looks like.

sentences.en: They were impressionable kids during the crash of 2008, when many of their parents lost their jobs or their life savings or both.
sentences.zh: 2008年金融危机发生时，他们正处在容易受影响的童年阶段，当时许多人的父母失去了工作、毕生积蓄，或两者兼失。

segments.text: They were impressionable kids during the crash of 2008, when many of their parents lost their jobs or their life savings or both.

sentences.en: They aren't interested in taking any chances.

segments.text: They aren't interested in taking any chances.

sentences.en: The booming economy seems to have done little to assuage this underlying generational sense of anxious urgency, especially for those who have college debt.
sentences.zh: 经济繁荣似乎并没有多少作用去缓解这一代人深层的焦虑和紧迫感，尤其是对那些背负大学债务的人而言。

segments.text: The booming economy seems to have done little to assuage this underlying generational sense of anxious urgency, especially for those who have college debt.

sentences.en: College loan balances in the U.S. now stand at a record $1.5 trillion, according to the Federal Reserve.
sentences.zh: 美联储数据显示，美国大学贷款余额如今达到创纪录的1.5万亿美元。

segments.text: College loan balances in the U.S. now stand at a record $1.5 trillion, according to the Federal Reserve.

sentences.en: One survey from Accenture found that 88 percent of graduating seniors this year chose their major with a job in mind.
sentences.zh: 埃森哲的一项调查发现，今年88%的毕业班学生在选择专业时就考虑到了未来工作。

segments.text: One survey from Accenture found that 88 percent of graduating seniors this year chose their major with a job in mind.

sentences.en: In a 2019 survey of University of Georgia students, meanwhile, the career office found the most desirable trait in a future employer was the ability to offer secure employment (followed by professional development and training, and then inspiring purpose).
sentences.zh: 与此同时，佐治亚大学就业办公室2019年的一项学生调查发现，未来雇主最受看重的特质是能够提供有保障的就业，其后依次是职业发展与培训，以及鼓舞人心的使命感。

segments.text: In a 2019 survey of University of Georgia students, meanwhile, the career office found the most desirable trait in a future employer was the ability to offer secure employment (followed by professional development and training, and then inspiring purpose).

sentences.en: Job security or stability was the second most important career goal (work-life balance was number one), followed by a sense of being dedicated to a cause or to feel good about serving the greater good.
sentences.zh: 工作安全或稳定是第二重要的职业目标（第一是工作与生活平衡），其后是投身某项事业的使命感，或因服务更大的公共利益而产生的满足感。

segments.text: Job security or stability was the second most important career goal (work-life balance was number one), followed by a sense of being dedicated to a cause or to feel good about serving the greater good.

sentences.en: That's a big change from the previous generation.
sentences.zh: 与上一代相比，这是一个很大的变化。

segments.text: That's a big change from the previous generation.

sentences.en: “Millennials wanted more flexibility in their lives,” notes Tanya Michelsen, Associate Director of YouthSight, a UK-based brand manager that conducts regular 60-day surveys of British youth, in findings that might just as well apply to American youth.
sentences.zh: 总部位于英国、定期对英国年轻人开展60天调查的品牌管理机构YouthSight副主任塔尼娅·米克尔森指出：“千禧一代希望生活中有更多灵活性。”这一发现同样可能适用于美国年轻人。

segments.text: “Millennials wanted more flexibility in their lives,” notes Tanya Michelsen, Associate Director of YouthSight, a UK-based brand manager that conducts regular 60-day surveys of British youth, in findings that might just as well apply to American youth.

sentences.en: “Generation Zs are looking for more certainty and stability, because of the rise of the gig economy.
sentences.zh: “由于零工经济兴起，Z世代正在寻求更多确定性和稳定。

segments.text: “Generation Zs are looking for more certainty and stability, because of the rise of the gig economy.

sentences.en: They have trouble seeing a financial future and they are quite risk averse.”
sentences.zh: 他们很难看清自己的财务未来，因此相当厌恶风险。”

segments.text: They have trouble seeing a financial future and they are quite risk averse.”
